name: mingdao-harness
description: MingDao Harness —— 开源智能体框架（Agent Harness）。零依赖、开箱即用，针对 DeepSeek-V4 系列优化，开放主流模型接入。
author: MingDao-Harness Contributors

scripts.prepublishOnly: node test/smoke.js && node test/e2e-local.js && node test/e2e-schedule.js
scripts.desktop:dist: node scripts/sync-versions.mjs && npm --prefix desktop run dist:dir
scripts.bench: node test/bench/bench-tokenizer.mjs && node test/bench/bench-routing.mjs && node test/bench/bench-compaction.mjs
scripts.preversion: node test/smoke.js && node test/e2e-local.js && npm run bench
scripts.postversion: git add package.json package-lock.json CHANGELOG.md 2>/dev/null; git commit -m "chore: release v$npm_package_version" --no-verify || true
